note: Reference prices read on the vendors' official pricing pages on the dates shown, as a visitor in Greece unless a comparison's assumptions name another country page. Not live pricing: revalidate before relying on any figure.
vat_note: Prices are before VAT where the vendor says whether VAT is included (see each comparison's assumptions and each calculator page's notes). Calculator tools marked "vat_removed": 0.24 were shown by the vendor including 24% Greek VAT; their prices here were divided by 1.24 and are before VAT.

assumptions: Deel Contractor Management reference rate $49 per contractor per month (volume discounts not modelled). Deel publishes no annual discount, so annual billing uses the same rate on both sides. Deel's employer-of-record (EOR) plans are priced separately and are not modelled; count contractors only.
Manual side is illustrative: $100/mo admin + $140 per contractor (wire fees, FX, contract review time).

Papaya Global publishes “starting from” prices (read 9 Nov 2026): Payroll Plus from $29 per employee per month, contractor management from $5, Contractor of Record from $199 and Employer of Record from $499 per person. The tool uses $29 per person (Payroll Plus); the final price is quoted.
The fragmented-vendor side is an editable estimate ($300/mo plus $220 per person) because local payroll providers do not publish comparable list prices; replace it with your own invoices.
Current side is illustrative: $30/mo fees + 3.9% conversion spread (typical PayPal/bank retail FX).
Airwallex Explore (US): no monthly fee, plus 0.5% above interbank for major currencies (1% for others). In some regions Explore carries a monthly fee unless waived.
No documented Airwallex weekend surcharge; the weekend share only affects sides that publish one.

Gusto Simple (US): $49 per month plus $6 per person (gusto.com/product/pricing, read 9 Nov 2026). Plus is $80 + $12 and Premium $180 + $22 per person. Gusto publishes no annual discount, so both billing options use the same price.
The Paychex side is an editable estimate ($85/mo plus $14 per employee): Paychex quotes per company and publishes no list price.
US list prices without promotional discounts; the QuickBooks plan is picked by its user cap.
Xero Growing includes unlimited users; multi-currency needs Xero Established (about $97/mo). US prices from 1 Oct 2026.

Ignition (US prices, read 9 Nov 2026): Core $149 billed monthly / $99 billed annually for 50 active clients plus $5 per extra client; Pro $279 / $229 for 350 clients (+$3 each); Pro+ $499 / $399 for 600 clients (+$2 each). The tool picks the cheapest published combination.
The manual side (PDF proposals, chasing invoices) is an editable estimate of admin time: $60/mo plus $4.50 per retainer client.

assumptions: Aspire publishes plans only for Singapore, Hong Kong and Australia (no EU page). On the Singapore page (read 9 Nov 2026) Basic costs $0 per month and FX on transfers starts at 0.46%; the card foreign-exchange fee is not published, so the 0.3% on card spend used here is an editable estimate.
The bank-card side is an editable estimate: $25/mo plus a 3.2% FX spread, with 0.5% extra on the weekend share. Check Aspire's plans for your country before relying on this.

Upwork client fees (upwork.com/pricing/client, read 11 Nov 2026): Basic plan 5% marketplace fee on payments to freelancers plus a one-time contract initiation fee of $0.99 to $14.99 per new contract (not modelled: add it to the one-time switching cost); Business Plus charges 10%, with an initiation fee of up to $4.99 only on fixed-price contracts under $100.
The staffing-agency side is an editable estimate ($200/mo plus a 28% markup on the freelance budget): agencies quote per engagement and publish no list price.

comparisons.from: Manual PDF Invoicing & Legacy Local ERP
comparisons.page_from_name: Manual PDF Invoicing & Legacy Local ERP
assumptions: Revolut Business Basic: €10 per month (Greek plan page, read 9 Nov 2026). The e-invoicing provider's per-invoice fee is an editable estimate (€0.04 per invoice) because the Greek myDATA/PEPPOL providers we tried to read (for example Elorus) block automated reading of their pricing pages; enter your provider's quote.
The manual side (PDF invoicing plus a legacy local ERP) is an editable estimate: €55/mo plus €0.45 of staff time per invoice. No annual discount on either side.

Shopify in EUR (shopify.com/pricing as shown in Greece, read 8 Nov 2026): Basic €27 billed monthly / €19 per month billed yearly, Grow €74 / €56, Advanced €384 / €289. Shopify does not limit SKUs, so Basic is used at every catalogue size; card fees and apps are extra. Shopify's prices vary by country.

The WooCommerce side is an editable estimate (€150/mo for hosting, backups and maintenance plus €18 per 100 SKUs in paid plugins and developer time): WooCommerce itself is free and hosting prices vary.

OTA side: Airbnb's host-only service fee of 15.5% (airbnb.com/help/article/1857, read 9 Nov 2026) is applied to the bookings that could move direct. Booking.com does not publish its commission (it varies by country and property), so edit the rate if yours differs.

Direct side: Lodgify Starter €33 per month billed monthly for 1 property (€26 a month billed yearly is not used; lodgify.com/pricing in EUR, read 11 Nov 2026), plus Lodgify's 1% transaction fee on online guest payments; Lodgify charges no booking fee on any plan. Only bookings that can realistically move direct count; direct bookings need your own marketing, enter that under “Extra monthly cost after switching”.

Mailchimp Standard, billed monthly, all stored contacts counted (incl. unsubscribed until archived). Regular Standard prices from mailchimp.com/pricing (checked 2 Nov 2026), not the 15% first-12-months offer for 10,000+ contacts; a count between two tiers is priced at the higher one, as on Mailchimp's page. Standard is sold up to 100,000 contacts (all 13 tiers re-checked on 9 Nov 2026); above that Mailchimp offers Premium (from $1,150 a month at 100,001 to 130,000) or custom plans, so a Standard price above 100,000 is extrapolated and flagged.

Brevo Starter priced by monthly email volume: 4 sends per contact per month. Each email tier also has a contact limit (brevo.com/pricing, read 9 Nov 2026: 5,000 emails up to 500 contacts, 10,000 up to 1,500, 15,000 up to 2,500, 20,000 and above up to 500,000), so the tool uses the first tier that covers both your email volume and your contacts.
Brevo logo removal add-on ($12/mo billed monthly, $10.80 billed yearly) not included.

ActiveCampaign Plus (1 user) by contact count, in EUR from activecampaign.com/pricing (checked 2 Nov 2026): €49 per month at 1,000 contacts, €189 at 10,000, €389 at 25,000, €609 at 50,000. ActiveCampaign publishes only annual-billing prices, so the same price is used for both billing options; monthly billing usually costs more, so ActiveCampaign's real cost may be higher. All 11 Plus tiers from 1,000 to 50,000 are included; a count between two tiers is priced at the higher one, as on ActiveCampaign's own calculator.

GetResponse Marketer by contact count, in EUR from getresponse.com/pricing (checked 2 Nov 2026; regular prices, without any temporary discount): €99 billed monthly / €81.18 billed yearly at 10,000 contacts, from €54 / €44.28 at 1,000 to €319 / €261.58 at 50,000. Above 50,000 contacts the price is extrapolated and flagged.

Current side: AWeber Lite by subscriber count (aweber.com/pricing.htm, read 11 Nov 2026 with both billing toggles): $15 billed monthly / $12.50 per month billed annually at 500 subscribers, $100 / $83.33 at 10,000, $600 / $500 at 100,000. Constant Contact's tier table could not be read, so it is not modelled.

ActiveCampaign Plus (1 user) in USD by contact count: $49 at 1,000, $189 at 10,000, $609 at 50,000 (activecampaign.com/pricing, read 9 Nov 2026). Only “billed yearly” prices are published, used for both billing options; above 50,000 contacts the price is extrapolated and flagged.

Substack charges no subscription: it takes 10% of paid-subscription revenue, and its help page also lists Stripe's card fee of 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction and a 0.5% billing fee on recurring payments (faq.substack.com; the 10% read 9 Nov 2026, the fee lines read on 18 Nov 2026). Kit's transaction fee on the Kit side already covers card processing, so both sides include it. Per subscriber the cost depends on your paid share and price, so $0.0485 per subscriber per month (for example 5% paid at $5/mo: 5% × ($5 × (10% + 2.9% + 0.5%) + $0.30)) is an editable estimate.

Kit Creator by subscriber count (kit.com/pricing, read 11 Nov 2026): $39 billed monthly / $390 per year at 1,000 subscribers, $139 / $1,390 at 10,000, $319 / $3,190 at 45,000, $679 / $6,790 at 105,000. Between listed tiers the next listed price is used. Kit's free Newsletter plan covers up to 10,000 subscribers without automations. Kit also charges 3.5% + 30¢ per transaction on paid subscriptions (every plan, kit.com/pricing); on the same example (5% paid at $5/mo) that is $0.02375 per subscriber per month, included on the Kit side.

Klaviyo Email plan by active profiles, all 49 slider steps from klaviyo.com/pricing (USD, read 9 Nov 2026): $20 at 500, $150 at 10,000, $720 at 50,000, $1,955 at 150,000; above that Klaviyo quotes. Klaviyo offers no annual discount. The Marketing (email + SMS) plan costs more.

Omnisend Standard by contacts, all slider steps from omnisend.com/pricing (USD, read 9 Nov 2026) at the regular monthly price, not the 30% three-months-upfront promotion: $16 at 500, $132 at 10,000, $413 at 50,000, $1,456 at 150,000. Prices exclude VAT.

Kit Creator by subscriber count, read from kit.com/pricing on 11 Nov 2026 (all slider steps from 1,000 to 125,000): $39 billed monthly / $390 per year at 1,000 subscribers, $139 / $1,390 at 10,000, $199 / $1,990 at 25,000, $679 / $6,790 at 105,000, shown per month. Between listed tiers the next listed price is used.

beehiiv Lite (beehiiv.com/pricing, read 11 Nov 2026, every slider step with both billing toggles): $59 billed monthly / $49 billed annually at 1,000 subscribers, $139 / $119 at 10,000, $199 / $169 at 25,000, $299 / $249 at 50,000, $469 / $399 at 100,000; between listed steps the next step's price is used. Pro (read 25 Oct 2026): $239 / $199 at 10,000.

HubSpot Sales Hub Professional: $100 per seat billed monthly, $90 billed annually. On Sales Hub Starter ($20 per seat regular price, monthly or annual, as shown on hubspot.com/pricing/sales on 9 Nov 2026; the current new-customer discount to $7 is not used) HubSpot is usually cheaper than Pipedrive Growth; choose Starter in the plan selector above to check. HubSpot's required one-time Professional onboarding fee ($1,500, stated on the same page) is not included.
Pipedrive Growth: $49 per seat billed monthly, $39 billed annually (Premium: $79 / $59) (pipedrive.com/en/pricing, read 25 Oct 2026).
Zoho CRM Professional: $35 per user billed monthly, $23 billed annually (Standard: $20 / $14). Source: zoho.com/crm/zohocrm-pricing.html, USD, read 9 Nov 2026.
Close Essentials: $49 per seat billed monthly, $35 billed annually (Growth: $109 / $99). Calling and SMS usage is billed separately. Source: close.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026.
The ZoomInfo / Lusha side is an illustrative estimate: both sell mainly through annual contracts quoted by sales.
Apollo.io Basic: $65 per user billed monthly, $49 billed annually (apollo.io/pricing, read 11 Nov 2026). Extra data credits are not included.

Salesforce Sales Cloud Core: $195 per user per month, billed annually; Pro Suite: $100, billed annually. Both are sold on annual terms, so the same rate is used for both billing options. Core includes Premier Success, Slack Business+ and Tableau Next; if you use them, add what replacing them would cost under “Extra monthly cost after switching”. Source: salesforce.com/sales/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026.
Freshsales Enterprise: $59 per user per month billed annually, $71 billed monthly (Pro: $39 / $47). Source: freshworks.com/crm/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026.
The RingCentral / Grasshopper side is an illustrative estimate: RingCentral no longer publishes list prices for its core plan.
Quo (formerly OpenPhone) Starter: $19 per user billed monthly, $15 billed annually (Business: $33 / $23). Source: quo.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026.
The current on-premise PBX side is an illustrative estimate.
Aircall Essentials: $40 per license per month billed monthly, $30 billed annually, minimum 3 licenses (Professional: $50 annually).

CallRail Lead Tracking (callrail.com/pricing, US, read 11 Nov 2026): $55 billed monthly / $50 billed yearly, including 5 local numbers and 250 minutes; each extra local number costs $3 a month. Extra minutes ($0.06 each) are not modelled.
Invoca sells by quote and publishes no price, so the Invoca side is an editable estimate: $250/mo plus $12 per tracked number.
Apollo.io Basic: $65 per user billed monthly, $49 billed annually (apollo.io/pricing, read 11 Nov 2026); its credit allowance is not modelled, so one seat is priced whatever the prospect volume.

Snov.io by credits per month (snov.io/pricing, read 9 Nov 2026; unlimited team seats): Starter $39 billed monthly / $29.25 annually for 1,000 credits, Pro S $99 / $74.25 for 5,000, Pro M $189 / $141.75 for 20,000, Pro L $369 / $276.75 for 50,000; one credit is assumed per verified prospect.

Amazon Polly itself is cheap: $16 per million characters for Neural voices (aws.amazon.com/polly/pricing, read 9 Nov 2026), about $0.016 per finished minute at roughly 1,000 characters a minute. The $150/mo plus $12 per minute here is an editable estimate for the studio voice-actor and editing work that Polly alone does not replace.

ElevenLabs by finished minutes (elevenlabs.io/pricing, USD, monthly billing, regular prices without first-month offers, read 9 Nov 2026): Starter $6 up to 30 min, Creator $22 up to 120, Pro $99 up to 600, Scale $299 up to 1,800, Business $990 up to 6,000; minutes follow the page's own calculator (about 1,000 credits per minute).

Descript by media hours per month (descript.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026): Hobbyist $24 billed monthly / $16 annually for 10 h, Creator $35 / $24 for 30 h, Business $65 / $50 for 40 h; above 40 h, media-hour top-ups from Descript's help centre are added (20 h $80, 50 h $150).
The manual editing side is an editable estimate of freelance or in-house editing time: $60/mo plus $45 per hour of finished video or podcast.

AdCreative.ai by credits (one credit per downloaded ad creative; adcreative.ai pricing page, USD, read 11 Nov 2026): Starter $39 billed monthly / $20 billed yearly for 20 credits, $89 / $45 for 50, $139 / $70 for 85, $189 / $95 for 120; Professional $249 / $125 for 300, $339 / $170 for 450, $400 / $200 for 600.
The designer / agency side is an editable estimate: $300/mo retainer plus $18 per ad variation.

Manychat by active contacts per month (manychat.com/pricing, USD, prices exclude tax, read 9 Nov 2026): Essential $17 billed monthly / $14 annually for 250 contacts, Pro $39 / $29 for 2,500, Business $99 / $69 for 7,500, Advanced $199 / $139 for 25,000; above that the price is extrapolated and flagged. One inquiry is assumed per active contact.
The manual side is an editable estimate of staff time: $150/mo plus $0.18 per comment or DM answered by hand.

Zapier Professional task ladder (750 to 2M tasks; all 17 tiers read on zapier.com/pricing on 9 Nov 2026). Above a plan's task limit, Zapier bills pay-per-task at 1.25× that plan's per-task price on annual billing and 2.5× on monthly billing (Zapier's own article on tasks, updated June 2026), up to 3× the limit; the tool uses whichever is cheaper, the next tier or pay-per-task.

Make Core credit ladder. Default: 1.5 Make credits per Zapier task, because Make also counts trigger runs and polling checks, which Zapier does not bill as tasks. This is an assumption, not an equivalence: set the multiplier from your own Make usage (1.0× fits long multi-step scenarios; 2.5× or more fits short scenarios, frequent polling, iterators and AI modules; the router itself uses no credits). Make prices as shown on make.com/pricing on 2 Nov 2026 to a visitor in Greece ($10.59 monthly / $9 yearly at 10k credits); Make may show different prices in other countries, so check the page from your own location.

Each workflow run has 5 action steps = 5 Zapier tasks (Zapier Professional ladder, all tiers read on zapier.com/pricing on 9 Nov 2026; above a plan's limit, pay-per-task at 1.25× on annual billing or 2.5× on monthly billing is used when it is cheaper than the next tier).
n8n Cloud bills per full workflow execution regardless of step count.
Above the published 50k Pro tier, n8n prices larger volumes individually; the tool extrapolates from the 50k tier and flags it.

n8n publishes prices in EUR (Starter €24 monthly / €20 annual, Pro 10k €60 / €50, Pro 50k €144 / €120); they are converted to USD at the ECB reference rate of 13 Nov 2026 (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD). When amounts are shown in EUR, the n8n side uses these EUR prices directly.
Jasper Pro: $69 per seat billed monthly, $59 billed annually (jasper.ai/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026); one seat is priced whatever the article volume because Jasper publishes no word cap for Pro.

Koala by words per month (koala.sh/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026), at an assumed 1,500 words per article: Starter $25 billed monthly / $20 annually for 45,000 words (about 30 articles), Professional $49 / $39 for 100,000, Boost $99 / $79 for 250,000, Growth $179 / $143 for 500,000, Elite $350 / $280 for 1,000,000. Writesonic now sells AI-search visibility plans with a monthly allowance of AI articles (Starter $79 per month billed annually with 15, Basic $199 with 25, Growth $399 with 50; writesonic.com/pricing, read 11 Nov 2026) and costs more at every size.

ElevenLabs by finished minutes (elevenlabs.io/pricing, USD, monthly billing, read 9 Nov 2026): Starter $6 up to 30 min, Creator $22 up to 120, Pro $99 up to 600, Scale $299 up to 1,800, Business $990 up to 6,000 (about 1,000 credits per minute, as on the page's calculator).

Murf Studio (murf.ai/pricing, USD, read 11 Nov 2026 with both billing toggles): Creator $29 billed monthly / $19 billed annually for 2 hours of voice generation a month (120 min), Business $99 / $66 for 8 hours a month (480 min); above 480 min/month Murf quotes (extrapolated and flagged).
The current side (Trello / Basecamp and spreadsheets) is an illustrative estimate.

monday.com Standard: $14 per seat per month, billed monthly or annually, minimum 3 seats (monday.com/pricing, read 11 Nov 2026; €14 as shown in Greece). The annual plan is currently shown at $12 with a “special offer” label; that is a promotion and is not used. The tool charges exactly the seats you enter (at least 3). monday.com sells seats in fixed team sizes, which are not modelled, so the bill can be for a few more seats than you use.
The current side (Asana Enterprise / Smartsheet) is an illustrative estimate.

ClickUp Core, the cheapest paid plan on ClickUp's pricing page (the earlier Unlimited plan is no longer listed): $12 per user billed monthly, $9 billed annually (Business: $25 / $17). Source: clickup.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026.
The Atlassian side is an illustrative estimate: Jira and Confluence per-user prices vary by plan and team size.
Notion Business (includes Notion AI): $24 per member billed monthly, $20 billed annually. Source: notion.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026.

DocuSign eSignature (ecom.docusign.com, USD, read 11 Nov 2026; tax may apply): monthly plans: Personal $15 for 5 envelopes a month, Standard $45 per user with 10 envelopes per user per month; annual plans billed monthly: Personal $11, Standard $30 per user with 100 envelopes per user per year. The tool buys the fewest Standard users that cover your contracts on each billing option. Standard is sold up to 50 users; above that DocuSign quotes (extrapolated and flagged).

PandaDoc Starter: $35 per seat billed monthly, $19 billed annually, with unlimited documents and e-signatures but up to 5 templates (pandadoc.com/pricing, read 11 Nov 2026); one seat is priced because volume does not change the price.

Webflow Premium site plan: $39 billed monthly, $25 per month billed yearly (webflow.com/pricing, USD per site, plus tax, read 9 Nov 2026). The CMS item cap of the plan is not stated on the pricing page, so the same price is used at every catalogue size.
The WordPress side is an editable estimate: $95/mo for managed hosting and maintenance plus $14 per 100 pages or items in paid plugins and developer time. WordPress itself is free.

Unbounce by monthly visitors (unbounce.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026): Starter $29 billed monthly / $22 annually up to 500 visitors, Build $99 / $74 up to 20,000, Experiment $149 / $112 up to 30,000, Optimize $249 / $187 up to 50,000; above that Unbounce quotes (extrapolated and flagged). One paid click is counted as one visitor.
The custom-development side is an editable estimate: $150/mo hosting and maintenance plus $28 per 1,000 clicks of developer and testing time.

Softr by external (client) users (docs.softr.io, USD, read 9 Nov 2026): Basic $25 billed monthly / $19 annually for 5 users, Pro $119 / $99 for 50 plus $1 per extra user up to 250, Business $395 / $329 for 100 plus $2 per extra user up to 500. The tool picks the cheapest published combination.
The Retool / Bubble side is an editable estimate ($50/mo plus $6 per external user): both charge per end user on plans that depend on the app.

comparisons.to: Bright Data Web Data & Proxy Network
comparisons.page_to_name: Bright Data Web Data & Proxy Network
assumptions: Bright Data residential proxies at list price (brightdata.com, USD, read 11 Nov 2026; the 50% three-month coupon is not applied): $8 per GB pay as you go; monthly plans of $499 at $7 per GB (about 71 GB), $999 at $6 per GB (about 166 GB) and $1,999 at $5 per GB (about 400 GB). The 141, 332 and 798 GB shown on the cards are the coupon allowances and are not used. The tool picks the cheapest published option; above 400 GB the price is extrapolated and flagged. Datacenter proxies cost less where they work.
The in-house side is an editable estimate: $250/mo of engineering time for scraper maintenance plus $22 per GB in blocked requests and retries.

Heroku Standard-1X dynos: $25 per dyno per month (512 MB; heroku.com pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026); Basic dynos cost $7 and Eco $5 for 1,000 shared hours. Heroku bills per second and publishes no annual discount.

Render: $7 per month per 512 MB web service or worker on the Hobby workspace (render.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026); 1 CPU / 2 GB instances cost $25 and the Pro workspace $25/mo extra. Railway bills the CPU and RAM a service actually uses ($0.00000772 per vCPU per second and $0.00000386 per GB of RAM per second; the Hobby plan's $5 and the Pro plan's $20 a month include that much usage; railway.com/pricing, read 19 Nov 2026), so it cannot be priced from a number of services: the amount shown on the new side is Render's. No annual discount on either side.

comparisons.from: WP Engine / Other Managed WordPress Hosting
comparisons.page_from_name: WP Engine / Other Managed WordPress Hosting
assumptions: WP Engine Essential: “starting at $28 per month billed annually” (wpengine.com/plans, USD, read 9 Nov 2026); the number of sites per plan and the monthly-billing price are not shown, so $28 per site per month is used for both billing options.

Cloudways Flexible servers (cloudways.com, USD monthly, read 9 Nov 2026): Micro 1 GB $14, Small 2 GB $28, Medium 4 GB $54, Large 8 GB $99; the mapping of about three small sites per GB of RAM is an assumption, so this side is marked partial. Nexcess did not show prices.

AWS: data transfer out to the internet at the rates on AWS's EC2 pricing page (aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/on-demand, US East (Ohio), the page's default region, read 19 Nov 2026): $0.09 per GB for the first 10 TB a month, $0.085 for the next 40 TB, $0.07 for the next 100 TB and $0.05 above 150 TB; above 500 TB a month AWS asks you to contact it, so the tool continues at $0.05 and marks the result as an estimate. The first 100 GB a month are free, aggregated across all AWS services and Regions; the tool assumes none of that free allowance is used elsewhere in your AWS account. Plus a NAT Gateway at $0.045 per GB processed (no free allowance) and $0.045 per hour (about $32.85 a month; VPC pricing page, read 19 Nov 2026). 1 TB is counted as 1,000 GB, also for the tier limits, so 1 TB costs $32.85 + $45 + $0.09 × 900 GB = $158.85; each further TB costs $135 up to 10 TB, then $130 up to 50 TB, $115 up to 150 TB and $95 above; the fixed part is $32.85 − $9 for the free 100 GB = $23.85 a month.

DigitalOcean: one $6 Basic Droplet includes 1,000 GiB of outbound transfer (digitalocean.com/pricing/droplets, read 19 Nov 2026); extra transfer is billed at $0.01 per GiB, and the allowance is pooled across the Droplets of a team (docs.digitalocean.com, read 19 Nov 2026). As on the AWS side, 1 TB is counted as 1,000 GB, which is 931.32 GiB: 1 TB fits in the allowance, 2 TB cost $6 + 862.65 GiB × $0.01 = $14.63, and each further TB costs $9.31. The amount shown on the new side is DigitalOcean's; Vultr is not priced here. No annual discount on either side.
Zendesk Suite Team: $69 per agent per month billed monthly, $55 billed annually. Source: zendesk.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026.

Gorgias by billable tickets (gorgias.com/pricing, USD monthly, read 9 Nov 2026): Starter $10 for 50 tickets, Basic $60 for 300, Pro $360 for 2,000 (then $0.25 per extra ticket), Advanced $900 for 5,000; Basic overage is $0.40 per ticket. The tool assumes 300 tickets per agent per month and picks the cheapest published combination. Gorgias's annual discount (“up to 17%”) is not itemised, so monthly prices are used for both billing options.

respond.io Growth: $159 per month (annual billing is 12 × monthly, so no discount) for 10 users and 1,000 monthly active contacts, plus $12 per extra 100 contacts (respond.io/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026). Starter is $79 for 5 users; Advanced $279 with $15 per extra 100 contacts.
The disconnected-inbox side is an editable estimate of staff time: $99/mo plus $14 per 100 conversations handled across separate apps.

Kajabi by contacts (kajabi.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026): Basic $179 billed monthly / $143 annually up to 2,500, Growth $249 / $199 up to 25,000, Pro $499 / $399 up to 100,000; students are counted as contacts.

Thinkific Start covers up to 10,000 current students (thinkific.com/pricing, read 9 Nov 2026, shown in EUR to a visitor in Greece: €79 per month billed annually, €107 monthly), converted to USD at the ECB rate of 13 Nov 2026 (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD); above 10,000 students Thinkific Plus is quoted (extrapolated and flagged). When amounts are shown in EUR, the Thinkific side uses these EUR prices directly.

LearnWorlds by monthly active learners (learnworlds.com/pricing, USD, prices exclude VAT, read 9 Nov 2026): Starter $49 billed monthly / $44 annually up to 1,000 learners (plus a $5 fee per paid enrollment, not modelled), Pro Trainer $99 / $79 up to 2,000; above that the price is extrapolated and flagged.
The self-hosted Moodle side is an editable estimate: $180/mo for hosting, updates and support plus $11 per 100 learners.

Gumroad: no subscription; on direct sales 10% plus $0.50 per sale, and once your paid sales reach $20,000 in a calendar month, 5% plus $0.50 on the further sales that month (gumroad.com help, read 19 Nov 2026). The tool charges 10% of your monthly sales up to $20,000, 5% of the part above, and $0.50 per sale: enter your number of sales per month. Sales through Gumroad Discover cost a flat 30% and are not modelled. Patreon charges a flat 10% of income with no such step and no fixed amount per sale (patreon.com/pricing, read 19 Nov 2026), plus payment processing, currency conversion and payout fees: for Patreon, enter 0 sales; above $20,000 a month the current side is then understated, so the saving shown is smaller than the real one. Card processing fees apply on both sides and are excluded.

Teachable (teachable.com/pricing, read 19 Nov 2026; regular prices, temporary offers are not used): Starter $39 billed monthly / $29 per month billed annually with a 7.5% transaction fee; Builder $89 / $69 with a 0% transaction fee when using Teachable Payments. The tool takes the cheaper plan at your sales: Starter up to $666 of sales a month billed monthly (up to $533 billed annually), Builder above. Growth ($189 / $139) is not used.

Mighty Networks Launch: $95 per month on monthly billing; on annual billing $950 per year, which Mighty Networks shows as $79 a month and the calculator counts as $79.17 a month (mightynetworks.com/pricing, read 20 Nov 2026 with the page's billing switch), unlimited members and a 2% transaction fee. Skool Pro costs $99 per month plus a 2.9% transaction fee on monthly billing (Hobby $9 with 10%; skool.com/pricing, read 20 Nov 2026).

Circle Professional: $89 per month on annual billing (circle.so/pricing, USD, taxes excluded, read 20 Nov 2026; Circle shows no monthly-billing price, so the calculator also uses $89 a month for monthly billing, and the real monthly-billing price may be higher), unlimited members, 2% transaction fee. Member count does not change the price on either side, so the member slider only affects your own estimates.

Subscriptions: Printful's own plan is free, and Printful Growth ($24.99 a month) becomes free once sales reach $12,000 a year, so no Printful subscription is counted (printful.com/pricing, read 11 Nov 2026). Gelato+ $29.99 billed monthly / $19.99 billed yearly (support.gelato.com, read 9 Nov 2026) is counted on the Gelato side at the monthly price.

The cost per order (product plus shipping) depends on your catalogue and destinations, so $16.50 per order on Printful (single warehouse, cross-border shipping) and $11.20 on Gelato (local production) are editable estimates; replace them with your own product prices.

ShipStation by shipments per month (shipstation.com/pricing, USD, read 11 Nov 2026 with both billing toggles): Starter $14.99 billed monthly / $11.99 billed annually for 50, $29.99 / $23.99 for 100, $39.99 / $31.99 for 500, $79.99 / $63.99 for 1,000, $119.99 / $95.99 for 2,000, $174.99 / $139.99 for 5,000; Standard $349.99 / $279.99 for 7,500 and $449.99 / $359.99 for 10,000.

Ship.com (ship.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026): Starter $4.99 a month for up to 10 shipments (monthly billing only), Growth $19.99 billed monthly / $14 billed yearly for up to 100, Executive $29.99 / $22 with unlimited shipments. Carrier label costs are excluded on both sides.
Zendesk Suite Team: $69 per agent per month billed monthly, $55 billed annually (Suite Professional: $149 / $115). Source: zendesk.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026.

Freshdesk Growth: $23 per agent billed monthly, $19 billed annually (Pro: $66 / $55). Source: freshworks.com/freshdesk/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026. Freshdesk Growth is a ticketing helpdesk; live chat and messaging comparable to Zendesk Suite need Freshdesk Omni, which costs more.
The LastPass / Dashlane side is an illustrative estimate.

1Password Business: $10.99 per user billed monthly, $8.99 billed annually, 1 user minimum. The Teams Starter Pack ($2.99 / $2.49 per user for 10 to 20 users) is not modelled. Source: 1password.com/pricing/business, USD, read 9 Nov 2026.

assumptions: Optery Core: $3.99 per person per month billed monthly, $3.25 billed annually ($39 a year; optery.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026); Extended costs $14.99 / $12.42 and Ultimate $24.99 / $20.70 per person. Aura's Family plan ($32 per month on annual billing for 5 adults) is an alternative not modelled.
The manual opt-out side is an editable estimate of staff time: $40/mo plus $35 per person per month.

Ahrefs by tracked keywords (ahrefs.com/pricing in EUR, read 11 Nov 2026 with both billing toggles): Lite €119 billed monthly / €1,190 a year for 750 keywords, Standard €229 / €2,290 for 2,000, Advanced €419 / €4,190 for 5,000 (annual prices shown per month); above 5,000 keywords Ahrefs quotes (extrapolated and flagged). Extra users cost from €37.40 each.

SE Ranking by tracked keywords (seranking.com in EUR, read 9 Nov 2026): Core €109 billed monthly / €87.20 annually for 2,000 keywords, Growth €235 / €188 for 5,000. Semrush Starter (€190 / €158.40 for 500 keywords, Pro+ €286 / €238 for 1,500) costs more at every size and is not modelled.

Salesforce Sales Cloud Core: $195 per user per month, billed annually; Pro Suite: $100, billed annually. Both are sold on annual terms, so the same rate is used for both billing options. Core includes Premier Success, Slack Business+ and Tableau Next; if you use them, add what replacing them would cost under “Extra monthly cost after switching”. Source: salesforce.com/sales/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026. Pro Suite is the closer match to HubSpot Sales Hub Professional and is selected by default; Core sits a tier higher (choose it in the selector above).

HubSpot Sales Hub Professional: $100 per seat billed monthly, $90 billed annually. HubSpot also charges a required one-time Professional onboarding fee ($1,500, stated on hubspot.com/pricing/sales on 9 Nov 2026); it is not in the monthly cost, so include it in the one-time switching cost above. Sales Hub Starter ($20 per seat regular price; a new-customer discount to $7 was shown on 9 Nov 2026) costs far less but lacks many Professional features.

Mailchimp Standard, billed monthly, all stored contacts counted (incl. unsubscribed until archived). Regular Standard prices from mailchimp.com/pricing (checked 2 Nov 2026), not the 15% first-12-months offer for 10,000+ contacts; a count between two tiers is priced at the higher one, as on Mailchimp's page. Standard is sold up to 100,000 contacts (all 13 tiers re-checked on 9 Nov 2026); above that Mailchimp offers Premium (from $1,150 a month at 100,001 to 130,000) or custom plans, so a Standard price above 100,000 is extrapolated and flagged.

MailerLite Comfort, from mailerlite.com/pricing (checked 2 Nov 2026): $12 billed monthly / $10.80 billed yearly at 500 subscribers, rising to $439 / $395.10 at 100,000. Comfort allows 10 monthly emails per subscriber; Power (unlimited emails) costs more ($69 / $62.10 at 5,000). All 19 Comfort tiers from 500 to 100,000 are included; a count between two tiers is priced at the higher one, as on MailerLite's own calculator.

ClickFunnels by contact limit, from clickfunnels.com/pricing (checked 2 Nov 2026): Launch $97 billed monthly / $81 billed annually (10,000 contacts), Scale $197 / $164 (75,000), Optimize $297 / $248 (150,000). Above 150,000 contacts the price is extrapolated and flagged (Dominate is sold only yearly, $5,997 per year). Plans also differ in team members, workspaces and courses.

systeme.io by contact limit, from systeme.io/pricing (checked 2 Nov 2026): Startup $17 per month (5,000 contacts), Webinar $47 (10,000), Unlimited $97 (unlimited contacts). Annual billing gives two months free (10 × the monthly price per year), shown per month. The free plan (2,000 contacts) is not used because it lacks paid features.

Hootsuite for one user, from hootsuite.com/plans (checked 2 Nov 2026): Standard $99 per month (up to 10 social accounts), Professional $199 (unlimited accounts); European visitors see €99 / €199. Hootsuite publishes only annual-billing prices; monthly billing appears only at checkout, so the annual price is used for both billing options. Each extra user adds the same price again.

Buffer Essentials (1 user), from buffer.com/pricing (checked 2 Nov 2026): billed monthly, $6 per channel for the first 10 channels, $4 for channels 11–25 and $3 for channels 26–50 (16 channels: $84); yearly billing is 10 × the monthly price per year (two months free), shown per month ($70 at 16 channels). Buffer Team (unlimited users) costs more.

Revolut Business, Greek plan terms (revolut.com/en-GR, read 9 Nov 2026): the cheapest of Basic €10 (€1,000 exchanged at the interbank rate), Grow €35 (€15,000) and Scale €125 (€60,000) per month; 0.6% on volume above the allowance, +1% on the share converted outside market hours (weekends), €5 per transfer beyond the plan's free transfers (one transfer per €3,000 assumed). Fees differ by country.

Wise Business for a Greek business (wise.com/gr/pricing/business, read 9 Nov 2026): no monthly fee, a one-time €60 set-up fee (put it in the one-time switching cost), and a conversion fee that varies by currency, from 0.2%. The tool uses EUR to USD from Wise's own calculator: 0.46% of the amount sent, 0.10 percentage points less on everything above €22,000 in a calendar month; EUR to GBP is 0.48%. Wise charges no per-transfer fee on top and publishes no weekend surcharge. Card, ATM and receiving fees are not included on either side.

plans.name: Wise Business above €22,000 a month (0.46% on the first €22,000)

assumptions: NordLayer (nordlayer.com/pricing, charged in USD, VAT extra, read 9 Nov 2026): Lite $10 per user per month billed monthly, $8 billed yearly; Core $14 / $11; Premium $18 / $14; every plan has a 5-user minimum, so a team of 2 to 4 pays for 5. Core and Premium also require a server with a dedicated IP at +$50 per month ($40 yearly), so a Core team pays $14 per user plus $50; the tool models Lite only (use your own unit rates for Core or Premium). Enterprise (from $6, 200 users minimum) is not modelled.

Proton VPN for Business (proton.me/business/vpn/pricing, shown in USD; the EUR page shows the same numerals, taxes may apply, read 9 Nov 2026): VPN Essentials $8.99 per user per month billed monthly, $6.99 billed yearly, minimum 2 users. VPN Professional ($11.99 / $9.99, adds SSO, private gateways and dedicated IPs at +$49.99 per IP per month, $39.99 yearly) and VPN and Pass Professional ($12.99 / $10.99, minimum 3) are not modelled; the Workspace Standard launch offer is promotional and not used. Both tools compare the entry plans (shared gateways, malware and phishing blocking, central user management); neither side includes dedicated IPs. When amounts are shown in EUR, the Proton side uses Proton's own EUR prices (€8.99 / €6.99), not a conversion; NordLayer charges in USD, so its side is converted.

Wix (wix.com/plans, USD, taxes extra, read 9 Nov 2026): Light $17, Core $29, Business $39 and Business Elite $159 per site per month, shown for yearly subscriptions paid in full; Wix does not show its monthly-billing prices on that page, so the yearly rate is used for both billing options; if you pay Wix month to month, your cost is higher than shown. Every Wix site needs its own plan, so the cost scales with the number of websites. Squarespace, often compared with Wix, publishes EUR prices for Greece including VAT (before VAT, the same basis as the Wix prices here: Basic €15 monthly / €11 annual, Core €24 / €17, Advanced €42 / €29 per site) and is not modelled here because of the different currency.

Hostinger (hostinger.com/web-hosting, shown in USD, read 9 Nov 2026): Premium covers up to 3 websites at $12.99 per month on a 1-month term or $10.99 per month at the 12-month renewal rate; Unlimited covers unlimited websites at $18.99 / $16.99. The first-term promotional prices ($3.99 / $4.99 per month for the first year, lower on 48-month terms) are not used. Cloud Startup ($27.99 / $25.99) is not modelled. Hostinger is hosting plus a site builder or WordPress, not the Wix editor: rebuilding each site is the real switching cost, so set the one-time switching cost to your own estimate. Domains, paid Wix apps and Hostinger add-ons are not included.

Norton Small Business (us.norton.com/products/small-business, USD, read 9 Nov 2026) is sold per employee with 2 devices each, on yearly terms: renewal price $119.99 a year for up to 3 employees (6 devices), $179.99 for up to 5 (10 devices), $249.99 for up to 10 (20 devices), shown here per month. The first-year promotions ($59.99 / $99.99 / $149.99) are not used. Norton publishes no plan above 10 employees, so above 20 devices the tool extrapolates from the 10-employee price and flags it. Small Business Premium ($299.99 / $399.99 a year at renewal) is not modelled.

Bitdefender GravityZone Small Business Security (bitdefender.com online configurator, US page, USD, taxes not included, read 9 Nov 2026) is licensed per device, 1 to 100 devices, annual terms only. The 1-year list price of every count from 1 to 100 devices was read from the configurator and is used as shown (for example 3 devices $105.99, 10 devices $324.99, 25 devices $734.99, 50 devices $1,319.99, 100 devices $2,574.99; shown per month). A larger pack sometimes costs less: 25 devices cost less than 24, 50 less than 46 to 49, and 100 less than 98 or 99; for those counts the tool uses the cheaper larger pack and names it. The 30% first-year promotion is not used. The Web Access and Device Control and Network Attack Defense add-ons ($41.99 a year each at 10 devices) are not included; add them in the extra monthly cost if you need them. Both products are yearly subscriptions, so the monthly and annual options show the same price.

assumptions: Typeform (typeform.com/pricing, EUR as shown in Greece, read 9 Nov 2026) is priced by included responses per month: Basic €35 billed monthly / €25 billed yearly for 100 responses and 1 user, Plus €70 / €49 for 1,000 responses and 3 users, Business €120 / €84 for 10,000 responses and 5 users. Above 10,000 responses the tool extrapolates from the Business price and flags it; Typeform sells Growth Flow (€242 a month) and Enterprise quotes there instead. The Contacts & Automations add-on (from €21 a month) is not included.

Jotform (jotform.com/pricing, EUR, read 9 Nov 2026) is priced by monthly submissions, one user per plan: Bronze €39 billed monthly / €34 billed annually for 1,000 submissions and 25 forms, Silver €49 / €39 for 2,500 and 50 forms, Gold €129 / €99 for 10,000 and 100 forms. The free Starter plan (100 submissions, Jotform branding) is not used, so up to 1,000 responses the Jotform side shows Bronze. Nonprofit and education discounts (50%) and Enterprise are not modelled. Typeform includes unlimited forms; Jotform caps them (25 / 50 / 100 by plan), so check the form count you need. Users differ too: Jotform's paid plans are for one user (more users only on Enterprise), while Typeform Plus and Business include 3 and 5 users, so if several people build forms the two sides are not equivalent.

Google Workspace (workspace.google.com/pricing, EUR as shown in Greece, taxes extra, read 9 Nov 2026): Business Starter €8.10 per user per month on the Flexible plan, €6.80 with a 1-year commitment; Business Standard €16.20 / €13.60; Business Plus €25.30 / €21.10 (choose the plan in the selector above). The introductory offer for new customers (50% off for the first months, first 20 users) is not used. Business plans are limited to 300 users; Enterprise is quoted.

Proton Mail for Business (proton.me/business/mail/pricing, EUR, taxes may apply, read 9 Nov 2026): Mail Essentials €7.99 per user per month billed monthly, €6.99 billed yearly, with 15 GB per user and 3 custom domains. Proton's Workspace Standard (€14.99 monthly) and Premium (€24.99) bundles add Drive, Meet, VPN and the password manager; their yearly prices are shown only as a 40% launch offer to 30 Nov 2026 and are not modelled. With the currency set to USD the same page shows $7.99 / $6.99, and the tool uses those prices when amounts are shown in USD (Google Workspace is then converted from EUR). Against Business Starter the price gap is small, so the decision is about end-to-end encryption, Swiss jurisdiction and the apps your team uses, not price; storage per user also differs (30 GB vs 15 GB).

FreshBooks (freshbooks.com/pricing, USD, read 9 Nov 2026) list prices: Lite $23, Plus $43 and Premium $70 a month, with yearly billing stated as an extra 10% off ($38.70 for Plus); the current 80%-off-for-four-months promotion is not used. The tool models Plus (up to 50 billable clients) plus the Team Members add-on at $11 a month per person besides the owner. Advanced Payments ($20 a month) and Payroll ($40 a month plus $6 per user) are not included.

Zoho Books (zoho.com/us/books/pricing, USD, taxes extra, read 9 Nov 2026): Standard $20 a month or $15 billed annually per organisation and includes 3 users; Professional $50 / $40, Premium $70 / $60. Each user beyond the included three costs $3 a month billed monthly or $2.50 billed annually. The tool models Standard: the owner plus two team members fit in the included users, and every further member adds $3 / $2.50. When amounts are shown in EUR, the Zoho side uses Zoho's own EUR prices (zoho.com/books/pricing as shown in Greece, read 9 Nov 2026: Standard €12 monthly / €10 yearly, 3 users included, extra user €3 / €2.50), not a conversion; FreshBooks charges USD, so its side is converted. Zoho's free plan for very small businesses is not modelled.

Calendly (calendly.com/pricing with the currency set to EUR, read 9 Nov 2026): Standard €12 per seat per month billed monthly, €10 billed yearly; Teams €20 / €16 (choose the plan in the selector above). Only people who host meetings need a seat; invitees do not. The Free plan (one event type) and Enterprise are not modelled. In USD Calendly's own prices are $12 / $10 and $20 / $16, and the tool uses them when amounts are shown in USD.

Zoho Bookings (zoho.com/bookings/pricing, EUR as shown in Greece, VAT extra, page dated 1 Oct 2026, read 9 Nov 2026): Basic €8 per user per month billed monthly, €6 billed yearly; Premium €12 / €9 adds online payments and more workspaces. Zoho Bookings is free for one user, which the tool does not use. The USD version of the same page lists Basic at $8 / $6 and Premium at $12 / $9, and the tool uses those prices when amounts are shown in USD. The tool compares Calendly Standard with Zoho Bookings Basic; check that the integrations you rely on (Zoom, Stripe, CRM) exist on the plan you choose.

Canva (canva.com/pricing, EUR, read 9 Nov 2026): Business €17 per person per month billed monthly or €170 per person per year (€14.17 a month); Pro is a one-person plan at €12 a month or €110 a year and is not a team product, so the tool models Business. Enterprise is quoted. Canva's page does not say whether VAT is included.

Adobe Express (adobe.com/express/pricing, Businesses tab, EUR excluding VAT, read 9 Nov 2026): Teams is an annual subscription billed monthly at the regular €6.72 per licence per month, with a 2-seat minimum (a single person pays for 2); the first-year offer of €4.20 is not used, and there is no separate monthly-commitment price, so both billing options show €6.72. The individual Premium plan (€9.99 a month before VAT; €12.39 with 24% Greek VAT on Adobe's page) and Enterprise are not modelled. Adobe Express covers fewer template and stock assets than Canva Business; price the features you actually use.

Harvest (getharvest.com/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): Teams $11 per seat per month billed monthly, $9 billed annually ($108 per seat a year). Harvest calls these "starting from" prices and says additional invoices, projects, clients and tasks are billed by usage as a team grows; those usage charges are not listed on the pricing page and are not modelled, so Harvest may cost more than shown. Harvest Enterprise ($17.50 / $14) matches Toggl Premium ($24 / $16) rather than Starter, so it is not offered here. The Free plan (1 seat, 2 projects) is not modelled.

Toggl (toggl.com/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): Starter $12 per user per month billed monthly, $9 billed annually; Premium $24 / $16 adds timesheet approvals and profitability reports. When amounts are shown in EUR, Toggl's own EUR prices are used (Starter €12 / €9 as shown in Greece), not a conversion; Harvest charges USD, so its side is converted. Toggl's Free plan covers up to 3 users and is not used here, so a team of 3 or fewer may pay nothing for basic tracking. Harvest Teams includes invoicing and expense tracking; Toggl's pricing page lists neither, so budget for a separate invoicing tool if you use them.

lemlist (lemlist.com/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): the Email plan, with unlimited users and sending mailboxes, is priced by emails a month: 50,000 for $69 billed monthly or $55 billed yearly, 100,000 for $89 / $71, 200,000 for $159 / $127, 500,000 for $359 / $287 and 1,000,000 for $659 / $527. Quarterly billing and the data add-ons (lead enrichment from $20 / $16 a month, intent signals from $29 / $21) are not included. Multichannel ($109 / $87 per user) adds LinkedIn, calls and SMS and is not modelled. When amounts are shown in EUR, lemlist's own EUR prices are used (the same figures in EUR, as shown in Greece), not a conversion.

Instantly Outreach plans (instantly.ai/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): Growth $47 per month billed monthly, $37.60 billed yearly, for 5,000 emails a month and 1,000 uploaded contacts; Hypergrowth $107 / $85.58 for 125,000 emails and 25,000 contacts; Light Speed $358 / $286.30 for 500,000 emails and 100,000 contacts; all with unlimited email accounts and warm-up. The tool picks the plan by emails per month; if you upload more contacts than the plan allows, you need the next plan. Instantly's lead database and credits are sold separately and not included. lemlist Multichannel also covers LinkedIn, calls and SMS, which Instantly's Outreach plans do not.

Dropbox (dropbox.com/business/plans-comparison, EUR as shown in Greece, read 10 Nov 2026): Standard €14.50 per user per month billed monthly, €12 billed yearly, for 1 user or more, starting at 3 TB for the team; Advanced €21.50 / €18 for 3 users or more, starting at 15 TB (choose the plan in the selector above). The page does not say whether VAT is included. Enterprise is quoted.

pCloud Business (pcloud.com/business.html, EUR, read 10 Nov 2026): €9.99 per user per month billed monthly, €7.99 billed annually, minimum 3 users, 1 TB per user, with client-side encryption. Business Pro (2 TB per user) costs €19.98 / €15.98 at its regular price; its 25% discount for new accounts is not used. Dropbox's storage is shared by the team, pCloud's is per user; compare against the space you actually use.

Otter.ai (otter.ai/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): Business $30 per user per month billed monthly, $19.99 billed annually, for up to 25 workspace members. Pro ($16.99 / $8.33) is limited to 5 members and 1,200 recording minutes, so the tool models Business for teams. The current 20%-off-for-3-months offer on monthly Business is not used. Enterprise is quoted. Above 25 members the Business price is flagged as an estimate.

MeetGeek (meetgeek.ai/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): Business $27 per user per month billed monthly, $17 billed yearly, with unlimited transcription; Pro costs $15.99 / $9.99 with 20 hours of transcription a month ($0.50 per extra hour). The tool compares Otter Business with MeetGeek Business. MeetGeek's 30% discount for startups, non-profits and education is not used. MeetGeek Business records up to 3 hours per meeting, Otter Business up to 4.

HubSpot Sales Hub Professional (hubspot.com/pricing/sales, USD, read 9 Nov 2026 and checked again 10 Nov 2026): $100 per seat billed monthly, $90 billed annually; the monthly option still commits you to a year. HubSpot charges a one-time Professional onboarding fee ($1,500, stated on the same page) when you start on Professional; it is not a cost of leaving HubSpot and is not included. HubSpot's Starter tier is not compared here.

Nutshell (nutshell.com/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): Pro $49 per user per month billed monthly, $42 billed annually; Business $67 / $59 and Enterprise $89 / $79; Foundation $19 / $13 and Growth $32 / $25. The tool compares HubSpot Sales Hub Professional with Nutshell Pro, which includes sales automation and advanced reporting. Nutshell's Marketing ($49 a month) and Engagement ($16 per user) add-ons are not included.

Motion (usemotion.com/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): Pro AI $29 per seat per month billed monthly, $19 billed annually, with 7,500 AI credits; Business AI $49 / $29 with 15,000 credits (choose the plan in the selector above). Extra AI credits are not included.

Reclaim.ai (reclaim.ai/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): Starter $12 per seat per month billed monthly, $10 billed yearly, for up to 10 seats; Business $18 / $15 for up to 100 seats; Enterprise is yearly only. The tool uses Starter up to 10 seats and Business above. Motion is a full project and task manager with an AI calendar, while Reclaim schedules tasks, habits and meetings on top of Google or Outlook Calendar; if you rely on Motion's projects, docs or Gantt charts, you need another tool for them.

Smartsheet (smartsheet.com/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): Pro $12 per member per month billed monthly, $9 billed yearly, for 1 to 10 members; Business $24 / $19 for 3 or more members. Choose the plan in the selector above: Smartsheet sells Pro only to new customers and only up to 10 members (above 10 the Pro price is flagged as an estimate), so if your team is on Business, choose Business; Smartsheet's free Contributors and Guests are not counted. When amounts are shown in EUR, Smartsheet's own EUR prices are used (Pro €11 / €8, Business €22 / €17), not a conversion.

Airtable (airtable.com/pricing, USD, read 10 Nov 2026): Team $24 per seat per month billed monthly, $20 billed annually, with 50,000 records per base and 25,000 automation runs a month; Business $54 / $45. Count the people who need a paid Airtable seat. The Free plan (up to 5 editors, 1,000 records per base) is not modelled.

Harvest (getharvest.com/pricing, USD, read 19 Nov 2026): Teams $11 per seat per month billed monthly, $9 billed annually ($108 per seat a year). Harvest calls these "starting from" prices and says additional invoices, projects, clients and tasks are billed by usage as a team grows; those usage charges are not listed on the pricing page and are not modelled, so Harvest may cost more than shown. Harvest Enterprise ($17.50 / $14, $168 per seat a year) adds profitability reports and timesheet approvals and is not offered here. The Free plan (1 seat, 2 projects) is not modelled.

Clockify (clockify.me/pricing, USD, prices without taxes, read 19 Nov 2026): Standard $6.99 per seat per month billed monthly, $5.49 billed annually; it is Clockify's first plan with invoicing and timesheet approval. Basic ($4.99 / $3.99) has no invoicing; Pro ($9.99 / $7.99) adds expenses, scheduling and labour cost and profit; Enterprise ($14.99 / $11.99) adds single sign-on. Clockify says every active or invited user on its Team page takes a paid seat, and VAT is added where Clockify must collect it. The Free plan has no invoicing and is not used here. Clockify's timesheet import needs Email, Start date, Start time and Duration columns; Clockify notes that a Harvest export has no e-mail column, so add it before importing.

Elicit (elicit.com/pricing, USD, read 19 Nov 2026): the page has an Industry view and an Academic view. Industry view: Pro $75 per user per month billed monthly, $49 billed yearly ($588 a year); Scale $375 / $229 ($2,748 a year) adds 5x usage, real-time collaboration and an admin panel. Academic view: Plus $19 / $11 ($132 a year), Pro $69 / $39 ($468 a year), Scale $149 / $89 ($1,068 a year) per user per month. Choose the plan in the selector above: the plans marked "academic prices" apply only to academic users, as labelled on Elicit's pricing page; the default is Pro at industry prices. Pro includes standard usage of Research Agent, Research Reports and Systematic Literature Reviews and a systematic review workflow that screens up to 5,000 papers. Enterprise is quoted; the free Basic plan (limited usage) is not modelled.

Consensus (consensus.app/pricing, USD, read 19 Nov 2026): Pro $20 per user per month billed monthly, $12 billed annually ($144 a year), with unlimited Pro messages and 15 Deep reviews a month; it is Consensus's first paid plan and the one used here. Deep ($65 / $45, $540 a year) has 200 Deep reviews a month; Teams ($30 / $20 per seat, $240 a year, up to 200 seats, 50 Deep reviews a month) adds account management and central billing; Enterprise is quoted. Extra usage costs $0.05 per credit and is not modelled. Students and faculty with a school email and US clinicians can get up to 40% off; that discount is not used. The free plan is not modelled.
